title: Recursive Self-Improvement on a Budget: Scoring Code Edits Before They Run
abstract: arXiv:2610.29121v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A coding agent that rewrites its own scaffold has to choose which proposed edit to expand before that edit has been evaluated, and the search then has to return one agent. Each run fits one linear readout on the parent's steering-split solve rate and eight coordinates of the proposed diff, from 96 scaffold edits labeled by four evaluations of a 16-instance fit split, and then freezes the coefficients. HumanEval+ reserves 48 instances as the steering split and Polyglot reserves 64. That split scores parents and keeps an archive of four nodes. Huxley-G\"odel Machine selection draws a parent by Thompson sampling on the steering counts of nodes that have already been evaluated, and it expands the child that parent proposes. Every method then returns the earliest evaluated node whose steering-split solve count is maximal. translated_title: 预算受限下的递归自我改进：在代码编辑运行之前对其进行评分
translated_abstract: 一个会改写自身脚手架的编码智能体，必须在该编辑被评估之前就选择要展开哪个提议的编辑，而搜索最终还必须返回一个智能体。每次运行都会基于96个脚手架编辑（这些编辑由16实例拟合分割的四次评估进行标注）来拟合一个线性读出器，其输入为父代在引导分割上的求解率以及提议差异的八个坐标，随后冻结这些系数。HumanEval+预留48个实例作为引导分割，Polyglot预留64个。该分割用于为父代评分并维护一个包含四个节点的存档。Huxley-Gödel机器选择机制通过汤普森采样，基于已被评估节点的引导分割求解计数来抽取一个父代，并展开该父代所提议的子代。之后，每种方法都会返回其引导分割求解计数达到最大的最早被评估的节点。表格报告了该节点在其余100个HumanEval+实例和其余145个Polyglot实例上的留出集分数。
tldr: 该论文提出一种预算受限的递归自我改进方法：利用由少量实例评估拟合并冻结的线性读出器，在代码编辑实际运行之前对其进行评分，使自改写的编码智能体能够在有限评估预算下高效选择最有前景的编辑。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a budget-constrained recursive self-improvement method that scores proposed code edits before running them, using a linear readout fitted on parent steering-split solve rates and diff coordinates and then frozen, enabling a self-rewriting coding agent to select the most promising edits under a limited evaluation budget.
